Counsel for plaintiff or the removing party is responsible for serving the Complaint or Notice of Removal, Summons and the assigned judge's standing orders and all other new case documents upon the opposing parties. For information, visit E-Filing A New Civil Case at http://cand.uscourts.gov/ecf/caseopening.Standing orders can be downloaded from the court's web page at www.cand.uscourts.gov/judges.                       1                               STIPULATION TO EXTEND TIME

                      2         Pursuant to Rule 6(b)(1) of the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure and Local Rule 6-1(a)

                      3   of the Northern District of California Civil Local Rules, Plaintiffs City of Richmond and

                      4   Richmond Joint Powers Financing Authority (collectively, “Plaintiffs”) and Defendants Royal

                      5   Bank of Canada, JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., and Public Resources Advisory Group

                      6   (collectively, “Defendants,” and, together with Plaintiffs, “the Parties”), by and through their

                      7   respective counsel, hereby stipulate as follows:

                      8          WHEREAS, on March 17, 2025, Plaintiffs filed their Complaint against Defendants in

                      9   California Superior Court for the County of Contra Costa (the “State Court Action”);

                  10             WHEREAS, on April 15, 2025, Defendants timely removed the State Court Action to

                  11      this Court;

                  12             WHEREAS, the current deadline for Defendants to respond to the Complaint is no

                  13      earlier than April 22, 2025, pursuant to Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 81(c)(2);

                  14             WHEREAS, Plaintiffs have clarified that their reference to Defendant “JPMorgan

                  15      Chase” in the Complaint is intended to refer to JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.;

                  16             WHEREAS, the Parties, through their respective counsel, have met and conferred in

                  17      good faith and have agreed to stipulate to an extension to the Defendants’ deadline to answer

                  18      or otherwise respond to the Complaint;

                  19             WHEREAS, the Parties have agreed to a 90-day extension, which will reset

                  20      Defendants’ deadline to answer or otherwise respond to the Complaint to July 21, 2025;

                  21             WHEREAS, Defendants waive any objection to the absence of a summons or service;

                  22             WHEREAS, with the exception of Defendants’ waiver of any objection to the absence

                  23      of a summons or service, the Parties and each of them expressly reserve and do not waive any

                  24      arguments or defenses by making this stipulation. Specifically, by entering into this

                  25      stipulation and seeking the extension requested herein, Defendants reserve and do not waive

                  26      any rights to challenge the sufficiency of the Complaint; and
